description: Initialize MCP session and verify a tool call succeeds (kernel_tasks_list)

actions.value: (async()=>{if(!window.__mcpReady)throw new Error('MCP not initialized');var r=await window.__toolCall('kernel_tasks_list',{limit:1});if(!r&&r!=='')throw new Error('Tool call returned empty');window.__mcpToolOk=true;window.__showResult('MCP tool check passed: '+r.substring(0,200))})()
